title: Slovakian-Style French Lasagna
description: A unique twist on the classic French dish, combining traditional Slovakian flavors with the comfort of lasagna.
instructions: Cook lasagna sheets according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a blender or food processor, blend chickpeas, ricotta cheese, parsley, garlic, salt, and black pepper until smooth.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add blended chickpea mixture and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in parmesan cheese and cook for an additional minute.
In a 9x13-inch baking dish, create a thin layer of the chickpea mixture. Arrange 4 lasagna sheets on top.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of chickpea mixture on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is lightly golden brown.
Let the lasagna rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
